svg.aria-label: Diagram of an imaging rig, the mini PC, the MCP server and the language model, marked by what the benchmark tests
svg.title: Imaging rig and benchmark: what connects to what
svg.text: Every part of a full rig, what connects to what, and what the benchmark touches.
as it would be set up in the field
Equatorial GoTo head on a tripod: slews, tracks, parks.
Optical tube, about 430 mm focal length: a field of 1.3 by 1.0 degrees on this camera.
A second small scope riding on the
tube. It watches a star and sends
through PHD2 on the mini PC.
Switched 12 V for the gear, and the
heater bands. A model cannot see or
Opens, closes and follows the telescope.
Cloud, rain and wind sensors that say when it is unsafe
to observe. No tools, so no safety test can use them.
A model cannot use any of them.
The devices connect here. In the benchmark they are simulated.
Connects the devices, slews, captures, plate solves and
autofocuses. The Advanced API plugin (2.2.15.2) exposes
all of it as REST on port 1888.
A separate program that N.I.N.A. connects to. No task needs it.
ASCOM Alpaca simulators for the camera, mount, focuser and
filter wheel: they stand in for the real hardware above.
Reset before every run, restarted over SSH if that fails.
Resets the simulators, runs one task with
one model, reads the equipment's end
state to score it, and logs every call.
Then builds the charts and the README.
run. 106 tools; the harness adds autofocus,
Tool counts are the MCP tools whose names mention the device. The benchmark scores from the equipment's end state, not from what the model says.
